event: Collective Eurazania poem accepted for festival performance
facts: After the audience approved the collective poem about Eurazania, Maestro Arlequino publicly declared it will be performed at the festival 'Фестиваль Эуразании: Неделя силы'.
Arlequino publicly added that the festival title was invented by the king; treat this as Arlequino's public claim unless independently verified elsewhere.
Audience response favored performing the poem again on the festival's large stage, with authors reading their parts.
The collective poem was created during the first Eurazania poetry evening by the gathered readers/authors including Tyren, Saila, Doren, Kern, Leyna, Marena, Reven, Mirael, Harn, Neyra, and Elira.
This adds a durable festival-program intention but does not by itself define final stage time, production slot, or organizer approval details beyond Arlequino's public announcement.
